sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS Our offering is being made on a self -underwritten basis. No minimum number of shares must be sold in order for the offering to proceed. The offering price per share is $0.05. The total offering amount is $900,000. We do not intend to employ a material amount of the net proceeds from the contemplated offering to discharge any current or future indebtedness of the Company. We plan to use the net proceeds we receive from this offering, after deducting the offering expenses payable by us, for the following purposes: • approximately 20% for hiring professionals to support company growth; • approximately 55% for upgrading our warehouse management system with advanced AI technology; • approximately 20% for working capital to support our day -to-day operations; and • the balance to fund for other general corporate purposes. sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt: DILUTION Dilution represents the difference between the offering price per share and the post -offering net tangible book value per share of our common stock immediately after this offering. Because the assumed offering price of $0.05 per share is less than our pro forma net tangible book value per share, purchasers of shares in this offering will not experience immediate dilution in net tangible book value per share; instead, they will experience an immediate increase in net tangible book value per share, while our existing stockholders will experience an immediate decrease in net tangible book value per share. As of June 30, 2026, our net tangible book value was $3,858,427, or $0.09 per share of common stock. sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt: DIVIDEND POLICY During the six months ended June 30, 2026 and the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we declared and paid a cash distribution of $250,000, $1,132,970 and nil to our shareholder, respectively, which was recorded as a reduction to retained earnings. Other than these distributions, we have not paid any cash dividends on our common stock as of the date of this prospectus. Our board of directors currently intends to retain any future earnings to support our operations and growth, and does not anticipate declaring or paying any dividends in the foreseeable future. We are organized under the Nevada Revised Statutes (the “NRS”), which prohibits the payment of a dividend if, after giving it effect, we would not be able to pay our debts as they become due in the usual course of business or our total assets would be less than the sum of our total liabilities.
